mentions.name: Nounogram
mentions.description: A hybrid nonogram and crossword puzzle game: shade the grid to find the layout, then add the words where they fit. The web version is live with apps coming. Originally built to get a child to practice handwriting.
mentions.problem: Finding a way to make a kiddo practice handwriting.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://nounogram.com/ (Web is live, apps soon) - Hybrid nonogram and crossword puzzles. Shade the grid to find the layout, then add the words where they fit. I built it to make the kiddo practice handwriting, and then it was more fun than I expected.
mentions.author: kristjan
